description: Surface Optimization of the (110) Surface of Rutile TiO2 (Tetragonal, P4_2/mnm) and Bridging Oxygen Vacancy Formation Energy Calculation
user_prompt: Compute the formation energy of a bridging oxygen vacancy on the rutile TiO2(110) surface (P4_2/mnm). Optimize both the clean slab and the slab with one bridging O removed, then compute E_vf = E(defective) - E(clean) + 1/2 * E(O2). Report E_vf in eV.
